commands.name: /pa temperature forecast
commands.description: Shows the weekly temperature forecast for the player's current biome.

commands.name: /pa temperature get
commands.description: Samples the current temperature for a biome id or the current biome aliases supported by the command helper.

commands.name: /pa temperature dayprofile
commands.description: Prints the current biome's daily temperature profile array.

commands.name: /pa temperature getseason
commands.description: Shows the current season/sub-season as reported by the active season provider.

commands.name: /pa temperature gettemp
commands.description: Prints raw and converted temperature values for the player's position.

commands.name: /pa temperature regenerate
commands.description: Clears/regenerates forecast cache data.

commands.name: /pa temperature resetSpikes
commands.description: Clears cached temperature spike simulation data.

commands.name: /pa temperature help
commands.description: Prints built-in help for the temperature command group.

commands.name: /pa humidity get
commands.description: Prints the humidity forecast array for the player's current region.

commands.name: /pa pressure get
commands.description: Prints the pressure forecast array for the player's current region.

commands.name: /pa windSpeed get
commands.description: Prints the wind forecast data for the player's current region.

commands.name: /pa spawncloud
commands.description: Spawns a cloud for the executing player through the Simple Clouds integration.

commands.name: /pa fog spawn
commands.description: Applies a client fog debug override to the executing player.

commands.name: /pa fog clear
commands.description: Clears the client fog debug override for the executing player.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug forecast
commands.description: Prints forecast, humidity, pressure, and wind information for the current position or a biome id argument.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug fog
commands.description: Prints fog heuristic inputs and tunables for the current position or a target block position.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug cpu
commands.description: Shows simple CPU/executor profile information used by the mod.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug rain
commands.description: Spawns a debug rain cloud near the target position.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug thunder
commands.description: Spawns a debug thunder cloud near the target position.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug snowstorm
commands.description: Attempts to spawn a debug snowstorm cloud.
commands.notes: Currently broken in source: the handler expects an intensity argument that the command tree does not expose.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug debugmode
commands.description: Toggles the in-memory Project Atmosphere debug mode flag.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug cloud
commands.description: Spawns a specific cloud id at the player's position.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug tornado risk
commands.description: Prints the computed tornado risk for the player's current region.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug tornado force
commands.description: Forces a tornado spawn with the given intensity.

commands.name: /pa weatherdebug tornado cooldown reset
commands.description: Clears the tornado cooldown for the player's current region.

commands.name: /pa spawnTornado
commands.description: Attempts to engage a tornado near the player, seeding or reusing a cumulonimbus cloud if needed.

commands.name: /pa cleartornadoes
commands.description: Clears all active tornadoes.

commands.name: /pa removetornado
commands.description: Removes a tornado near the executing player.

commands.name: /pa spawnHurricane
commands.description: Spawns a hurricane near the player in a valid ocean biome.
commands.notes: Alias: /pa spawnHurricanes. Overworld only. Category range is 1..5.

commands.name: /pa clearhurricanes
commands.description: Clears all active hurricanes.

commands.name: /pa removehurricane
commands.description: Removes a hurricane near the executing player.

commands.name: /pa debug export
commands.description: Client debug command that exports telemetry archives when telemetry is enabled.
commands.notes: Registered on the client command dispatcher.

commands.name: /pa debug open
commands.description: Client debug command that opens the telemetry folder when telemetry is enabled.
commands.notes: Registered on the client command dispatcher.

commands.name: /dumpcloud
commands.description: Client debug command that captures the current cloud render texture.
commands.notes: Registered on the client command dispatcher.

notes: Current server commands are rooted under /pa.
The README still mentions /weatherdebug directly, but the current source registers /pa weatherdebug instead.
An undocumented /pa weatherdebug <resource_location> path exists in source for cloud violence reporting; it is omitted here because the syntax is unstable and not user-friendly.
